subject.title: [Bug]: Unscheduled reminder guard fires for isolated-session crons + counter lost during compaction

question: Should maintainers adopt the open fork fix candidate, replace it with a target-repo ClawSweeper fix, or wait on the contributor branch?
rationale: Current main still has the bug, but an exact closing PR exists outside the target repository and is currently conflicting, so automation should not queue a duplicate fix without maintainer intent.

options.title: Replace With Target-Repo Fix
options.body: Use the fork PR as source material if helpful, but open a narrow target-repo replacement with isolated-cron and compaction-counter regression coverage.

options.title: Adopt The Fork PR
options.body: Review, refresh, and merge the existing fork PR if maintainers are comfortable taking that branch forward.

options.title: Wait On Fork PR
options.body: Leave this issue paired with the fork PR and accept that the current bug remains on main until that branch is resolved.

recommendation.title: Replace With Target-Repo Fix
recommendation.body: Use the fork PR as source material if helpful, but open a narrow target-repo replacement with isolated-cron and compaction-counter regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the best available routing owner from the prior same-area merge/refactor history and current helper provenance.
